title: Chapter 556 - 556 Makeup; Imperfect Romance!

Chapter 556 - 556 Makeup; Imperfect Romance!

Chapter 556 - 556 Makeup; Imperfect Romance!

556 Makeup; Imperfect Romance!

Desmartin’s visit was only the beginning.

Then, the presidents of Tesla, Facebook, Google, Microsoft, and Asiacom also knocked on Lin Fan’s door and talked about cooperation.

Some were like Desmartin, proposing to acquire the patent, while some invited Lin Fan to join their organization. A few invited Lin Fan to take up a position…

At the start, Lin Fan rejected and responded to them one by one.

However, as the number of people increased, Lin Fan felt that it was too troublesome.

Therefore, he hung a ‘do not disturb’ sign at the door.

The entire world finally returned to silence.

Today, Lin Fan stayed in the luxurious suite and chatted with his parents and sister. He tasted the dishes that the attendant served and looked at the beautiful scenery outside the window. He was extremely satisfied.

…

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

Of course, when Lin Fan opened the door, he found Liu Zihao waiting for him at the door.

Lin Fan said, “I accidentally slept a little longer. You must have waited long.”

Liu Zihao waved his hand. “Professor Lin, you must be tired from the long journey yesterday. You should have a good rest. Besides, I’ve only been here for a while.

“Should I ask the attendant to bring breakfast up, or should we go down together?”

“I’ve already asked the waiter to bring breakfast,” Lin Fan said.”

He knew that if he went downstairs, he would be pestered by some people.

It was too troublesome.

Liu Zihao nodded. “That’s good. Let’s get the makeup artist to help you confirm your style first.”

“I still need to get makeup done?” Lin Fan was stunned.

Liu Zihao said, “After all, it’s an international awards ceremony. Make-up can make one look more energetic and handsome.”

Lin Fan said, “But I’m already handsome enough.”

Lin Xiaoyao, who was in the luxurious suite, heard the voices and walked over. She smiled and said, “Brother, who would complain about being more handsome?”

“Why does it feel like you just want to see me with makeup on?” Lin Fan asked.

The smile on Lin Xiaoyao’s face widened.

Obviously, this was the truth.

At this moment, Dai Weixue and Lin Tao also walked out.

“Lil Fan, just put on makeup. You might even be on TV later,” Lin Tao said.

“Yeah,” Dai Weixue said.

Lin Fan really wanted to say that even if he appeared on TV, his front profile would not be shot.

However, since his parents had spoken, he naturally had to listen.

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Alright, let’s put on makeup, then.”

After Liu Zihao heard Lin Fan agree, his face lit up. He said to the beautiful woman beside him, “Sorry to trouble you.”

“It’s alright,” the beautiful makeup artist said.

The beautiful makeup artist and Lin Fan had a simple discussion about makeup.

At this moment, the attendant pushed the dining cart over.

“Professor Lin, please have your breakfast first,” Liu Zihao said.

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied.

Nuts, egg rolls, bread, beef slices, chicken cubes, egg tarts, crab rolls… There were many types, but the amount was very small.

This made Lin Xiaoyao, who liked to taste fresh food, extremely satisfied.

After eating his fill, Lin Fan went to the dressing table.

It had to be said that the beautiful makeup artist was quite capable.

Light red lips, refreshing hairstyle, and a brand new suit…

Lin Fan, who was already handsome, seemed to have turned into the perfect male lead in a youth romance drama.

Even Lin Xiaoyao, who had been with him all day long, could not help but open her mouth wide and praise, “Brother! You’re so handsome!”

Lin Fan said, “When am I not handsome?”

Lin Xiaoyao did not care much. She quickly took out her phone and gestured with her hands. “Brother, let’s take a group photo! Let’s smile together!”

In the photo, Lin Fan’s face was calm while Lin Xiaoyao was smiling brightly.

Lin Xiaoyao pouted.

“One more!”

Lin Fan replied with a smile.

Lin Xiaoyao made a peace sign again.

Seeing the photo…

Lin Xiaoyao nodded in satisfaction.

How would she know that these were the only two photos of Lin Fan in the world in the past two years?

“Professor Lin, it’s almost time. Why don’t we go over first?” Liu Zihao asked.

Lin Fan nodded. “Dad, Mom, let’s go.”

“Alright, alright,” Lin Tao and Dai Weixue responded.

At this moment, the three Audis from yesterday were already waiting in the parking lot.

…

About ten minutes later…

The ancient and towering buildings appeared before his eyes.

It was the Golden Hall!

The Golden Hall was an ancient building in Swede. It was only open during the Nobel Prize ceremony.

At this moment, in front of the Golden Hall Square, there were many foreigners people holding lanterns, singing, or holding banners. The banners read ‘Congratulations to Professor Lin Fan for winning four Nobel Prizes…’

It was extremely lively, just like the Spring Festival.

Lin Fan, Lin Xiaoyao, Lin Tao, Dai Weixue, and the rest all looked over curiously.

If it was in Hua Nation, it would be fine.

However, this was overseas.

This surprised everyone.

Liu Zihao said, “The Hua Nation students in Swede know that Professor Lin has won four Nobel Prizes. So, they came from all over to celebrate. It seems that they started dancing and beating drums here two days ago.”

When Lin Fan and the rest heard this, their hearts warmed up for some reason.

Even though they were far away from home, they could still feel the touch and warmth brought by the same bloodline.

Finally, the Audis slowly stopped at the entrance of the Golden Hall.

After showing their identification and going through the relevant security checks, Lin Fan and the rest finally walked in.

The exterior of the Golden Hall was very ancient, and the interior was also filled with a sense of history.

There were many guests in the Golden Hall today. As far as the eye could see, it was filled densely. Greetings and laughter rang out… The entire Golden Hall became extremely noisy.

Due to the long construction time, the designer at that time probably did not expect this building to be the host of a world-renowned top-class event. As a result, the area of the Golden Hall was not too big, making the current banquet hall seem a little crowded.

“So many people…” Lin Xiaoyao could not help but say.

“But this place has red walls. Why is it called Golden Hall?”

Liu Zihao, who was beside her, said, “Someone said that the designer originally planned to design it in gold. However, it seems that due to financial reasons, the project was suspended. So, it looks like this now.”

Lin Xiaoyao blinked her big eyes and said in disbelief, “So, this is an unfinished building?”

Liu Zihao was speechless.

Unfinished building?

The Nobel Prize award ceremony was held in an unfinished building?

If others heard this, they would probably be speechless.

Liu Zihao coughed dryly and said, “Perhaps we can call it… an imperfect romance.”
